projectDescription: A professional desktop application for film and TV post-production that automates the full dailies workflow — from verified camera card offload through AI-powered metadata analysis, audio/video sync, and native NLE export into Avid, Premiere, and DaVinci Resolve.
keyFeatures: Checksum-verified multi-destination media offload with MHL, receipts, and HTML directory snapshots
Transcode-during-offload to DNxHR MXF OP-Atom, ProRes, H.264/265 directly to Avid MediaFiles
AI-powered slate detection (YOLO + GPT-4o Vision) with transcript-based fallback via Deepgram Nova-3
Timecode, waveform, and visual clap sync with multicam grouping
One-click native NLE export: Avid .avb bins, Premiere .prproj, DaVinci Resolve .drp — no NLE app required
Bin structure builder with metadata column mapping, color labels, and stringout sequences
Client dashboard publishing at dashboard.cocreate.so with per-roll ingest log, sync status, and reports
Expected-roll delivery validation with missing-roll detection and clip-count checking
Portable .ccrt project files with automatic media relinking
Offline/airgapped mode with on-device Parakeet ASR transcription via Apple Neural Engine
Per-project reports: PDF/CSV roll reports, media reports, contact sheets, volume summaries
Pro subscription ($99/mo) with 14-day trial; Permafree tier with 2 analysis-minutes limit
publicApiSurface: Card Manager: Transfer, verify, and transcode camera card media
Expected Deliveries: validate a delivery against a manifest of expected rolls
Ingest Log: per-step operational audit trail, CSV export, dashboard sync
AI Analysis Pipeline: slate detection, transcription, metadata propagation
Slate fields: scene, take, roll, camera, date, director, tags
Audio/Video Sync: timecode sync, waveform sync (BBC cross-correlation), multicam grouping
Bin Structure Builder: drag-and-drop NLE export configuration with presets
Export targets: Avid (.avb + OP-Atom MXF), Premiere (.prproj), Resolve (.drp), XMEML, FCPXML
Organize Drive: folder hierarchy builder with dynamic tags, copy/move execution
Dashboard publish: versioned project snapshots, org roles, hosted review media
Reports: PDF/CSV per project, per roll, per scene; HTML directory snapshots
Subscriptions: Pro plan (~$99/mo), Permafree plan, 14-day trial, bypass codes
Auth: email/password and Google OAuth via Supabase
